journal_lines: Flash of yellow in the wall. Spent extra time here.
Dense rock, then yellow. Worth the work.
Glint in the torchlight. Took all of it.
Yellow in the dark like a slow sunrise. Worked toward it.
Gold does not rust, does not tarnish, does not forget. Carried it home gently.
A streak so thin it might have been a trick of the light. It was not.
Found a nugget the size of a tooth. Almost set it down. Did not.
The vein turned where the rock turned. The rock turned often.
Heavy in the bag the way only gold is heavy. The bag remembered.
Soft metal. Easy to take. Easy to lose. Did not lose it.
Older than the people who first wanted it. Will outlast the next ones too.
